name: NeRFCodec
definition: An end-to-end NeRF compression framework that integrates non-linear transform, quantization, and entropy coding for memory-efficient scene representation of plane-based hybrid NeRF.
summary: NeRFCodec is an end-to-end compression framework that achieves memory-efficient scene representation by adapting a pre-trained 2D neural image codec to compress hybrid NeRF feature planes.
